entry.title: A ball to push through
entry.summary: The appendix describes a box with three balls over three holes, offering a different way to push and release. The authors’ mouthing and secure-parts conditions still apply.
entry.cue: Your baby is pressing objects with a hand and watching what happens.
detail: This example is pushed with the hands in the illustrated movement list. The child’s interest may be in one push or in repeating the movement.
